out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed a GRAS listed grill cleaner stored on a shelf below chemicals.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. CLEANER WAS RELOCATED TO A HIGHER SHELF.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage Prohibited under Open Stairwells
violations.observation: Packaged bread items stored on a rack under the drying section of the 2 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Food may not be stored under areas where subject to splash.

violations.title: Gloves, Use Limitation (Single-Use Gloves)
violations.observation: Observed employee at grill handling raw meat with gloved hands and failed to remove gloves before closing grill top.
violations.corrective_action: If used, single-use gloves shall be used for only ONE task and used for no other purposes. The single-use gloves shall be discarded when damaged or soiled or when interruptions occur in the operation. DISCUSSED PROPER GLOVE USE AT GRILL STATION.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no cover to the feminine napkin refuse container in the ladies room stall.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: EHS observed a food employee put raw hamburger on grill and touch handle of grill top.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS EDUCATED CFM TO HAVE STAFF WEAR GLOVES WHILE HANDLING RAW HAMBURGER MEAT, REMOVE GLOVES ONCE MEAT IS ON GRILL, AND PULL DOWN GRILL TOP AFTERWARDS.

violations.title: Gloves, Use Limitation (Single-Use Gloves)
violations.observation: EHS observed employee with gloves on, hand customer change and then proceed to take a container and fill with fries.
violations.corrective_action: If used, single-use gloves shall be used for only ONE task and used for no other purposes. The single-use gloves shall be discarded when damaged or soiled or when interruptions occur in the operation. EHS INFORMED CFM. CFM HAD STAFF MEMBER REMOVE GLOVES AND WASH HANDS.

violations.title: Gloves, Use Limitation (Single-Use Gloves)
violations.observation: Single use gloves observed improperly used in the following manner: observed employee with gloved hands open two doors to provide food to customer, return to the kitchen and attempt to continue preparing foods.
violations.corrective_action: If used, single-use gloves shall be used for only ONE task and used for no other purposes. The single-use gloves shall be discarded when damaged or soiled or when interruptions occur in the operation. EHS INFORMED EMPLOYEE TO REMOVE GLOVES BEFORE STARTING FOOD PREPARATION.
